title: On-Chain Behavioral Signatures for Classifying Centralized Exchange Addresses on Ethereum Using Proof-of-Reserves
abstract: arXiv:2610.41888v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Centralized exchanges (CEXs) are key gateways between traditional finance and digital asset markets, yet identifying their blockchain addresses remains challenging. Existing approaches often rely on opaque attribution labels or treat exchanges as secondary classification targets, leaving generalization to unseen exchanges insufficiently examined. This study develops a classification framework using Proof-of-Reserves (PoR) disclosures, with 3,033,857 Ethereum addresses from 15 CEXs and five Non-CEX categories. We derive 58 on-chain behavioral features and evaluate LightGBM against logistic regression (LR) under a leave-one-exchange-out protocol. Across five lookback windows (30-730 days), LightGBM consistently outperformed LR, with macro PR-AUC increasing from 0.6611 to 0.9594 using the selected 17 features, compared with 0.7697 for LR at 730 days. translated_title: 基于储备证明的以太坊中心化交易所地址分类的链上行为特征研究
translated_abstract: 中心化交易所（CEX）是传统金融与数字资产市场之间的关键门户，然而识别其区块链地址仍然具有挑战性。现有方法通常依赖于不透明的归属标签，或将交易所视为次要分类目标，导致对未见过的交易所的泛化能力未得到充分检验。本研究利用储备证明（PoR）披露信息构建了一个分类框架，涵盖来自15个CEX和5个非CEX类别的3,033,857个以太坊地址。我们提取了58个链上行为特征，并在留一交易所交叉验证协议下，将LightGBM与逻辑回归（LR）进行了比较评估。在五个回溯时间窗口（30-730天）中，LightGBM始终优于逻辑回归，使用精选的17个特征后，宏观PR-AUC从0.6611提升至0.9594，而逻辑回归在730天时仅为0.7697。鲁棒性检验显示，在特征选择和超参数调优情况下，模型仍保持了相近的性能表现。
tldr: 本研究利用储备证明（PoR）披露信息提取58个链上行为特征，在留一交易所验证协议下使用LightGBM实现了对以太坊中心化交易所地址的高精度分类，宏观PR-AUC达到0.9594，显著优于传统逻辑回归方法。
en_tdlr: This study leverages Proof-of-Reserves disclosures to extract 58 on-chain behavioral features, achieving high-accuracy classification of Ethereum centralized exchange addresses (macro PR-AUC of 0.9594) using LightGBM under a leave-one-exchange-out validation protocol, significantly outperforming logistic regression.
